(Can't Stack) When your "New Unit-02" is summoned, you can summon this card from your Hand to directly brave to that Spirit, without paying the cost. When you've done so, you can draw two cards.

[During Brave]
Treat this Spirit as having [Soul Core] on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
By discarding three cards from your Hand, during this turn, this Spirit's "BP Destruction effects" can't be prevented by opposing effects.

CB23-054.name: So It's Really Completed
CB23-054.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set]
When your Hand is discarded via your effect, you can send five cores from an opposing Grandlwalker Nexus to the Void.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal a card from the opposing decktop. If that card is Cost 8 or more, you draw a card. Return the revealed card to the decktop or deckbottom.

CB23-041.name: Suzuhara Toji
CB23-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can summon/deploy an “Ikari Shinji”/“Aida Kensuke” from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can summon an "Ikari Shinji" Brave card from your Hand to directly brave it to your Spirit.

CB23-040.name: Suzuhara Toji & Aida Kensuke
CB23-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Unit-01" can't attack.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) By destroying this Nexus, during this turn, give every "Unit-01" Spirit you control the effect: "(When Attacks) Send three cores from an opposing Spirit to the Trash."

CB23-053.name: That's Why Young Men Are Problematic
CB23-053.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Turn)
Every "WILLE" family Spirit you control gains +5000 BP.

[Flash]
During this turn, while your "WILLE" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't summon Spirit cards/Brave cards from their Hand via effects.

CB23-029.name: The 10th Apostle -GeoFront Battle-
CB23-029.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "The 9th Apostle" has left the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, you can destroy an opposing Cost 10 or less Spirit. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. Then, you can discard five cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

CB23-026.name: The 4th Apostle -Self-Destruction-
CB23-026.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "The 4th Apostle" would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can discard this card from your Hand. When you've done so, discard three cards from both player's decktop.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

CB23-028.name: The 6th Apostle -Attack Mode-
CB23-028.effect:
While there is any "Angel" family card in your Trash, this set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of cost 10. This effect can't be prevented by [A.T. Field]. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost. Or, if you control any "Angel" family Spirit, set this card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

CB23-027.name: The 8th Apostle -On The Verge of Landing-
CB23-027.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "The 8th Apostle" attacks/blocks, you can discard this card from your Hand. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit, and for each cost of that destroyed Spirit, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV1][LV2] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, discard four cards from the opposing decktop.

CB23-051.name: The Directed Hatred
CB23-051.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set]
Increase the limit of your "WILLE" family "BP Destruction effects" by +3000.

[Flash]
Destroy every opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit, and the effects of the destroyed Spirits can't activate. Then, you can +1 core to one of your exactly-named "Katsuragi Misato -WILLE-".

CB23-048.name: The Giants of Light
CB23-048.effect:
When this card is revealed from deck by your Blue effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Angel" family Spirit attacks, during that battle, by fixing its symbol as zero, discard two cards, but up to as many as possible, from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn: Same Name) When you are summoning an "Angel" family card, for each symbol-less Blue Nexus you control, you can reduce that card's cost by -1.

CB23-045.name: The New Tokyo-3 City
CB23-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, you can return up to three "Evangelion" from your Trash to the deckbottom. Also, once per turn, if that opposing Spirit has the "Angel" family, you can return an "Evangelion" from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
When you're summoning an "Evangelion", fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

CB23-035.name: The Spear of Gaius
CB23-035.effect:
One copy of this card/Brave can brave to a Spirit that is braved to "Ikari Shinji" you control, ignoring the number of Braves on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
If your Life is five or less, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from the Trash to your Life.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
While braved to "Unit-01", during this battle, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

CB23-059.name: To a World Which Evangelion Is Not Needed
CB23-059.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Unit-01" that is braved to "Ikari Shinji" depletes/destroys opposing Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Void.

[Flash]
Send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Then, if there are "Evangelion" on either player's Field, you can destroy all "Evangelion"/"EVANGELION", and the effects of the destroyed Spirits can't activate. This destruction effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

CB23-009.name: Unit-13's Arm Unit
CB23-009.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) If you control any Purple "NERV" family Spirit, you can summon this card from the Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When this Spirit blocks, or is blocked, send a core from the opposing battling Spirit to the Reserve.

CB23-042.name: Village-3
CB23-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can summon/deploy a "Suzuhara Toji"/"Aida Kensuke"/"Ayanami-Rei (Tentative Name)" from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Ikari Shinji" is summoned/deployed, you can draw a card.

CB23-055.name: What I Want Was Just Someone Stroking My Head
CB23-055.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Turn)
Your "WILLE" family "BP Destruction effects" can't be prevented by opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit effects.

[Flash]
By braving a Spirit-condition "Pilot" family Brave with your Spirit, during this battle, that Spirit gains +5000 BP. Then, if that Brave is "Shikinami", that Spirit can refresh.
